servinfo.title: Engine Lubrication Description
servinfo.ptxt: A vane type variable displacement oil pump is incorporated in the timing chain cover and is driven by the crankshaft.

Oil is drawn up through the oil pump strainer and passes through the pump to the oil filter. The filtered oil flows into an oil cooler and then to the main oil gallery in the cylinder block. Oil passing through the oil cooler is cooled by flowing coolant from water jacket in the cylinder block to the cylinder head. Oil from the main gallery is supplied to the crankshaft main bearings and cylinder head. Through backside of crankshaft No.1 main bearing, an oil passage is connected to a sub gallery for piston cooling jets and tensioner adjuster. Another oil passage in the timing chain cover supplies oil from the main gallery to exhaust OCV. The following devices are lubricated or pressurized by delivered oil as follows.

item.ptxt: Crankshaft journal

Main bearings supporting crankshaft journals are lubricated and the oil is supplied to the connecting rod bearings by means of intersecting passages drilled in the crankshaft, and then splashed from the big end of each connecting rod to lubricate cylinder wall, piston pin, piston and piston rings.
Timing chain oil jet

Oil from an oil passage between the main gallery and No.1 main bearing is supplied to the jet and injected for lubrication of the timing chain, timing sprockets, timing chain tensioner and timing chain guide.
Piston cooling jet
A piston cooling jet valve located at the sub gallery controls on / off of the oil flow. And, oil is injected through the jet to each piston effectively only when necessary.
Tensioner adjuster
Oil from an oil passage connected to No.1 main bearing backside provides pressure to the tensioner adjuster for adjustment of the chain tension.
Cylinder head
Oil from the main gallery is supplied to camshaft front lower housing and then divided into passages drilled in the cylinder head at intake side and exhaust side independently.
Exhaust VVT actuator
Oil is supplied from exhaust OCV to cylinder head through the timing chain cover, camshaft front housing and exhaust camshaft for the camshaft timing control.
Camshaft journal

Oil is supplied through the passages in the cylinder head at intake side and exhaust side except exhaust No.1. Exhaust No.1 journal is lubricated by oil from OCV through passages in camshaft front upper housing.
Hydraulic lash adjuster
Through the same passages for the camshaft journals, oil is supplied. From the top of each hydraulic lash adjuster, oil is injected to the valve rocker arm according to the stroke.
Valve rocker arm and cam surface
Splashed oil from the top of the hydraulic lash adjuster lubricates the valve rocker arm including its roller bearing and corresponding cam surface.
High pressure fuel pump and tappet
Injected oil through a small hole drilled in camshaft intake rear housing lubricates the high pressure fuel pump and tappet including roller and cam.
Vacuum pump
Oil is supplied from intake side oil passage in the cylinder head passing through the thermostat case.
Turbocharger
Oil is supplied through a turbocharger oil feed pipe connected to the main gallery by an oil union bolt providing mesh filter.
The oil pump itself controls oil pressure maintaining necessary oil volume avoiding wasteful engine load.

The oil filter provides a relief valve to bypass oil when oil pressure exceeds the filter’s specification caused by clogging of the filter element due to poor maintenance (without changing the filter as scheduled). In this situation, dusty oil will circulate in the engine without filtration and causes the engine damage.

For market code E02 and E22 model, vehicle is equipped with the oil life monitoring system. This system informs the driver that the engine oil must be replaced by blinking of oil change request light. For more details of oil life monitoring system, refer to Oil Life Monitoring System Description .
